It was released on **October 6, 2026**! ![:rocket:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/rocket.png?v=14) [![ga-dark](https://d25dw3ppwbkamw.cloudfront.net/optimized/1X/34d1f0d51a143181fff85854e0e7f1af705342bf_2_690x388.jpeg)\\ ga-dark1920×1080 237 KB](https://d25dw3ppwbkamw.cloudfront.net/original/1X/34d1f0d51a143181fff85854e0e7f1af705342bf.jpeg "ga-dark") This release targets Platform 2.1.3 and arrives alongside major updates across the Neat ecosystem. It empowers customers to build more responsive live-video pipelines, expand spatial-awareness and inspection applications, and bring image understanding and voice interaction directly onto Modalix. ## ![:sparkles:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/sparkles.png?v=14) What Palette Neat 0.5.0 Brings to the Table - **Advanced Queue Overflow Policies:** New queue options allow you to block, keep the latest frame, or drop incoming frames. Live pipelines can now stay current instead of building up latency, giving you control over the trade-off between processing every frame and responding to the latest scene. - **Nonblocking Input:**`ModelRunner::try_push()` allows applications to keep capture and other workflows responsive even when inference queues are full. - **Metoak Camera & Stereo Depth:**`CameraInput` adds Metoak SIMOR support and introduces a new `MetoakDepth` node for EV74. Customers can now combine recognition with 3D position for depth-aware inspection and robotics applications. - **New BoxDecode Family & Faster Decoding:** We’ve added support for YOLOX segmentation and pose, plus an MLA-only PCIe route to integrate Modalix into host pipelines that handle their own preprocessing. Additionally, BoxDecode is now much faster: a 250-class BF16 model jumped from 5.63 to 37.82 FPS on Modalix. - **Qwen3.5 & Gemma 4 Advancements:** Qwen3.5 vision-language models (0.8B to 9B) now run on Modalix for local text-and-vision applications. Furthermore, embedding tables can now be offloaded to NVMe to free up DRAM, enabling Gemma 4 to run alongside other models on a 16GB SoM. - **Expanded Voice Workflows:** LLiMa adds Whisper large-v3-turbo for improved multilingual speech-to-text. Meanwhile, GenAI Studio now features an OpenAI-compatible audio API and uses Supertonic 3 on the MLA as its default text-to-speech engine. - **Powerful New Applications:** Apps 0.5.1 introduces RF-DETR detection and segmentation (up to 70 FPS at 1080p on Modalix) as a ready-to-run starting point for inventory monitoring. It also adds FastFlow anomaly detection, which allows you to train on good parts and view live defect heatmaps in Insight. - **Quantization-Aware Training (QAT):** Our first release of QAT 1.0.0 for PyTorch models exports a quantized ONNX model that Model Compiler can compile directly, providing a training-based path to recover accuracy while retaining your existing datasets. - **Browser Webcam for Insight:** Insight 0.0.8 allows you to use your browser’s webcam directly as an RTSP source for any Neat app, making it easier to try live-camera applications without setting up a separate network camera. ## ![:books:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/books.png?v=14) Dive Into the Release Notes Palette Neat 0.5.0 is delivered as a coordinated set of components. Review the component-specific release notes for complete changes, installation guidance, and additional compatibility information: - ![:blue_book:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/blue_book.png?v=14)[Neat Core v0.5.0](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/core/releases/tag/v0.5.0) - ![:puzzle_piece:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/puzzle_piece.png?v=14)[Neat Internals v0.5.0](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/internals/releases/tag/v0.5.0) - ![:brain:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/brain.png?v=14)[LLiMa v0.5.0](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/llima/releases/tag/v0.5.0) - ![:mobile_phone:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/mobile_phone.png?v=14)[Neat Apps v0.5.1](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/apps/releases/tag/v0.5.1) - ![:desktop_computer:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/desktop_computer.png?v=14)[Neat Insight v0.0.8](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/insight/releases/tag/v0.0.8) - ![:bar_chart:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/bar_chart.png?v=14)[QAT v1.0.0](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/qat/releases/tag/v1.0.0) - ![:laptop:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/laptop.png?v=14)[Neat SDK v2.1.3.1](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/sdk/releases/tag/v2.1.3.1) - ![:hammer_and_wrench:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/hammer_and_wrench.png?v=14)[`sima-cli` v2.1.18](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://github.com/sima-neat/sima-cli/releases/tag/v2.1.18) ## ![:link:](https://community.sima.ai/images/emoji/twitter/link.png?v=14) Get Started Today The SDK installs the complete Neat development environment, including the matching runtime, Core library, Insight, and development tools: `sima-cli neat install sdk@v2.1.3.1` We can’t wait to see what you build!
